bane.description: Targets with stxample trained add {Df}. Effect: Taal, the lord of the hunt, stirs the nearby beasts into a mighty fury. While this blessing is recharging, all natural beasts within medium range become feral and aggressive. Domesticated beasts add {Dc} to all Animal Handling checks to control them, and may attack their handlers. Wild beasts behave aggressively, attacking the nearest creature not of their species
